title: Query Kth Smallest Trimmed Number
statement:
Given equal-length digit strings `nums` and queries `[k, trim]`, keep the rightmost `trim` digits of every number. Return the original index of the `k`th smallest trimmed value. If trimmed values tie, the smaller original index comes first. Return answers in query order.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = ["102", "473", "251", "814"], queries = [[1, 1], [2, 3]]
Output: [2, 2]
```

```text
Input: nums = ["001", "001", "100"], queries = [[1, 3], [2, 3], [3, 1]]
Output: [0, 1, 1]
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length, queries.length <= 100`
- `1 <= nums[i].length <= 100`; all strings have equal length and contain digits.
- `1 <= k <= nums.length`
- `1 <= trim <= nums[i].length`
